newsitem.title: USA: Fidelity Select Home Finance fund manager resigns.
newsitem.headline: Fidelity Select Home Finance fund manager resigns.

text.p: Fidelity Investments said Friday David Ellison, manager of Fidelity Select Home Finance fund, is leaving the mutual fund company effective October 1.
"He's leaving on October 1 and he's leaving to pursue a new opportunity in the financial services industry," Fidelity spokeswoman Robyn Tice said. "He hasn't confirmed what he is doing."
Ellison has managed the $759 million fund since December, 1985 and has produced among the best returns in the sector by investing in banks and home lenders.
